traps.name: Stereo ignored
traps.note: Connectivity is right, stereochemistry is wrong.

traps.name: Wrong regiochemistry
traps.note: Same formula and groups, wrong position.

traps.name: Over-reacted
traps.note: Went further than the reagent allows (e.g., DIBAL to alcohol).

traps.name: Under-reacted
traps.note: Stopped short (e.g., Grignard added once to an ester).

traps.name: Workup missing
traps.note: Product still shows an alkoxide/charge that acidic workup would remove.

traps.name: Wrong enolate
traps.note: Kinetic vs thermodynamic alkylation site swapped.

traps.name: Friedel–Crafts on deactivated ring
traps.note: FC alkylation/acylation fails on strongly deactivated rings.

traps.name: Grignard with acidic proton
traps.note: OH / NH / COOH present — Grignard gets quenched.

traps.name: Wrong directing effect
traps.note: Placed the substituent as if the group had the opposite directing effect.
